papers.title: Uncertainty Quantification in Graph Neural Networks with Shallow Ensembles
papers.saved_takeaway: Shared SchNet encoder with64 final energy heads; Gaussian NLL uses mean and variance. OC20 fine-tuning freezes encoder. Studies shift-sensitive uncertainty; not isolated predictive-quality effect of tying versus independent GNNs.
papers.relationship_to_candidate: Direct shared graph encoder/head prior; complete private graph trajectories need a competent head-only control for a claim that they improve neighbourhood specialization.

papers.title: CAMERO: Consistency Regularized Ensemble of Perturbed Language Models with Weight Sharing
papers.saved_takeaway: Shared bottom/private top networks; independently perturbed representations, mean own task loss and prediction-consistency regularization. BERT inference one encoder plus averaged private-head logits. Frozen encoder/new classifier quality diagnostic does not isolate tying.
papers.relationship_to_candidate: Direct accuracy-oriented shared/perturbed ensemble prior; attribute representation reuse and variability control. Current exact tied/untied graph-view contrast remains unanswered.

new_suggested_control_only_after_positiv: Common modern graph encoder plus four private heads with same fixed views, all TRAIN labels and pooling. This architecture adaptation is not a faithful CAMERO reproduction; no execution admission.
